questions: Ordered questions, each addressing one fact or decision.
questions.options: Up to three single-choice answers. Omit this field or use [] for free-text only.
questions.options.description: Concrete meaning, effect or tradeoff of this option.
questions.options.label: Distinct option label; append `(Recommended)` if strongly recommended.
questions.question: Complete user-visible question.
questions.reason: Brief user-visible explanation of why the answer is needed and what it affects.
